What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into SIS & registries without inventing a shadow estate. What makes Education & Research different is not the math; it is the operating context: GDPR / privacy regimes governs the data, learning analytics governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
